6C8D9C.text: {window:04}Arcadia's crown prince and the hero of this game. He escapes the Emperor's invasion, which targets the space-time transporter. With the Three Beast Knights, he seeks to reclaim his kingdom.

6C8E7D.text: {window:04}One of Arcadia's Three Beast Knights. A descendant of the Ancient Zoidians, she teaches and watches over the prince. She is serious, responsible, and a little meddlesome. She knows much about ancient technology.

6C8F78.text: {window:04}One of Arcadia's Three Beast Knights and a former Guylos Imperial officer. He offers the prince an Imperial perspective. Quiet but sharp-tongued, he excels at melee combat.

6C9065.text: {window:04}One of Arcadia's Three Beast Knights and a former Helic Republic officer. He advises the prince from the Republic's perspective. He leads the Three Beast Knights and serves as the prince's sensible strategist.

6C9162.text: {window:04}A Zoid-loving boy from Wind Colony. He meets Fiona and the Organoid Zeke in ancient ruins, then travels to discover Fiona's past. His Zoid is the Shield Liger, later the Blade Liger.

6C9251.text: {window:04}A descendant of the Ancient Zoidians. After the fight with Prozen, she searches for Zoid Eve with Van. Later she becomes Dr. D's assistant. She remains a little absent-minded.

6C933E.text: {window:04}He first seeks Van's Organoid Zeke, but becomes a friend during their travels. He pilots a Command Wolf. His eye patch contains a camera that can record images.

6C941F.text: {window:04}A courier of the wastelands who unexpectedly joins Van's journey. She acts as a big sister to Van and Fiona, sometimes stern and sometimes kind. Her theme song is famous.

6C950C.text: {window:04}A Republic captain who meets Van at Red River and notices his unusual powers. Stubborn and reckless, he stays on the front lines and earns his troops' trust. He is the President's son.

6C95FD.text: {window:04}A Republic lieutenant colonel and Colonel Krueger's deputy. He often commands troops in the colonel's place. He is a steady commander with little taste for showmanship.

6C96C2.text: {window:04}A Republic lieutenant and Captain Herman's deputy. He stays with Herman on the front lines and shares his stubborn streak. He hires Moonbay at Red River.

6C97A1.text: {window:04}A Republic colonel recalled from the reserves during the Guylos invasion. He counters the Empire with clever tactics and is known as a battlefield magician. He served alongside Van's father.

6C98A4.text: {window:04}Two years after the battle with Death Saurer, he has become an excellent Zoid pilot under Colonel Krueger. As a Guardian Force member, he keeps fighting for peace.

6C9991.text: {window:04}Her Ancient Zoidian memories return, and she becomes Dr. D's skilled assistant. Joining the Guardian Force brings her back to Van's side. She remains absent-minded.

6C9A76.text: {window:04}He remains a bounty hunter after the Death Saurer battle, then joins the Guardian Force's travels. A friend and rival to Van and Thomas, he fights beside them to the end.

6C9B67.text: {window:04}A wasteland courier drawn into the Guardian Force's travels. Herman chooses her to pilot Ultrasaurus, which she treats as her own. Sadly, she has no chance to perform a new song.

6C9C6E.text: {window:04}An Imperial major, later colonel, who leads the First Armored Division. From a respected military family, he is an experienced field commander. Good or bad, difficult assignments seem to find him.

6C9D77.text: {window:04}An Imperial lieutenant, Guardian Force member, and Karl's younger brother. He uses BEEK, an AI he built and claims exceeds an Organoid's abilities. He falls for Fiona at first sight.

6C9E6E.text: {window:04}Leader of the desert bandits Desert Arcobaleno and a former Imperial special forces soldier. Marcus's plot lands him in prison. After escaping, he kidnaps Rudolph but ends up protecting him.

6C9F6B.text: {window:04}A Desert Arcobaleno member. After Rosso's arrest, she hides underground and later helps him escape prison. She joins Rudolph's kidnapping. Her home is Mount Iselina.

6CA050.text: {window:04}He loses his memory after losing to Van and wanders until it returns. Hiltz brings him back into battle. He pilots Geno Breaker, though even Shadow can control it only briefly.

6CA139.text: {window:04}An Ancient Zoidian with the blue Organoid Specular. She excels at psychic attacks and often works alone. After Hiltz betrays her, she joins Raven, who saves her life.

6CA236.text: {window:04}A former junk dealer who meets Liger Zero and becomes a Blitz Team Zoid Warrior. His dream is to travel the world.

6CA317.text: {window:04}Dr. Toros's daughter and a Blitz Team warrior. Cute but fierce, she charges headlong into battle. A selfish troublemaker, she may take after her father.

6CA406.text: {window:04}A freelance Zoid Warrior hired by the Blitz Team. He is very strict about money. He pilots Command Wolf until an incident leads him to Shadow Fox.

6CA4F9.text: {window:04}Dr. Toros's dependable assistant, Blitz Team tactician, and mechanic. Usually gentle and kind, his personality changes when he pilots Raynos.

6CA5DE.text: {window:04}A former Blitz Team warrior who leaves to train and find his ideal Zoid. He returns with a red Blade Liger and teams with Naomi. Dr. Toros's son and Leena's brother.

6CA6E5.text: {window:04}A beautiful marksman known as the Red Comet. She wins solo battles without teammates. Leon saves her from danger in a Dark Battle, and they form a team.

6CA7E6.text: {window:04}A man born to be a champion. His wealth buys the finest Zoids for his Champ Team. He loves Leena and sees Bit as his rival.

6CA8C7.text: {window:04}One of the Emperor's Four Generals. Like Earth, she comes from the Empire. Normally calm, she openly shows hatred when facing Earth. What happened between them?

6CA9A6.text: {window:04}One of the Emperor's Four Generals. Once a Republic soldier and Jack's mentor, he now stands against Jack for reasons of his own.

6CAA81.text: {window:04}One of the Emperor's Four Generals. A leading Imperial Zoid researcher, he was exiled for dangerous experiments. This mad scientist joins the Four Generals to continue his research.

6CAB6C.text: {window:04}A leading member of the Emperor's Four Generals and trusted by the Emperor. His burning ambition knows no limits. He is the prince's rival.

6CAC4B.text: {window:04}The mysterious figure behind the sudden invasion of Arcadia. Nobody knows the face beneath his mask. He conquers the kingdom in one night and claims the title of Emperor.

6CAD28.text: {window:04}A Zoid pilot raised by Prozen. Though he hates Zoids, he is a gifted pilot. With the black Organoid Shadow and Geno Saurer, he fights deadly battles against Van.

6CAE19.text: {window:04}An Ancient Zoidian with the red Organoid Ambient. He revives Death Stinger and destroys the Republic. Later he absorbs Dark Kaiser and fuses with Death Saurer to threaten the world.

6CAF14.text: {window:04}Despite his gentle appearance, he is cruel and cowardly. He enjoys using poison gas and watching others suffer. At taverns, he drinks milk for health and beauty.

6CB023.text: {window:04}The Tigers Team fields three Zaber Fangs. After losing to the Blitz Team, they lose repeatedly. Dr. Laon helps them recover, but their unlucky losing streak returns.

6CB10E.text: {window:04}A researcher at Arcadia's Zoid Lab. A certain event draws him into reviving Star Liger, the King of Arcadia's Zoid.

6CB1F3.text: {window:04}A Backdraft member. This mysterious group rejects Zoid Battle Commission rules and runs Dark Battles with illegal tactics. Its members hijack Zoid battles and cause trouble everywhere.

6CB2E0.text: {window:04}A Guylos Imperial marshal, later regent. He plots to kill Rudolph and become Emperor. At the same time, he revives Death Saurer to take over the world.

6CB3AD.text: {window:04}Prozen, fused with Death Saurer's core. He secretly manipulates Hiltz and Reese to revive himself with Zoid Eve's power. Hiltz has already planned for this.

6CB4A0.text: {window:04}A famous Republic scientist who retires to research artificial snow. As fighting grows, he returns to help Van and friends with supplies and encouragement. He puts salt in his coffee.

6CB5B7.text: {window:04}The former Emperor's grandson. Rosso kidnaps him before his coronation. Hunted by Prozen's assassins, he travels with Van to Guygalos, defeats Prozen, and becomes Emperor, bringing peace.

6CB6AE.text: {window:04}A Champ Team member led by Harry and a maiden in love. Benjamin loves a Judge and challenges Commission headquarters to meet him. The feelings seem mutual.

6CB79F.text: {window:04}A Champ Team member led by Harry. One of the rare members with a reasonable amount of common sense.

6CB846.text: {window:04}The team's manager and mechanic. A skilled but hard-to-read engineer, rumored to be simply a Zoid fanatic. He is Leon and Leena's father.

6CB937.text: {window:04}Dr. Toros's rival since their student days. He repeatedly challenges the Blitz Team and loses. The Backdraft Group later recruits him, and he plans further contests.

6CBA2C.text: {window:04}A fair referee and the law of Zoid battles, sent by the Zoid Battle Commission. As long as he is there, justice wins!

6CBAEF.text: {window:04}An AI referee for Dark Battles. It crushes the Judge and hijacks battles, though the Judge sometimes fights back.

6CBBC6.text: {window:04}The Judge of Judges, who oversees the Colosseum final.

6CBC4D.text: {window:04}Van's white Organoid companion, awakened by Van alongside Fiona. Always by Van's side, he supports Shield Liger and Blade Liger.

6CBD2C.text: {window:04}Raven's black Organoid. Hiltz destroys him, but he revives and attacks Raven. Raven's tears bring him back to his senses.

6CBDFD.text: {window:04}Reese's blue Organoid. He can draw out a fused Zoid's abilities beyond their limits.

6CBE9C.text: {window:04}Hiltz's red Organoid. He has mysterious powers, including joining Death Stinger's Zoid cores into one.

6CBF51.text: {window:04}The prince's father. The Emperor captures him during the invasion of Arcadia. His whereabouts remain unknown.

6CC000.text: {window:04}The prince's mother. The Emperor captures her during the invasion of Arcadia. Her whereabouts remain unknown.

6CC0E9.text: {window:04}Hero of the second Game Boy game, Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after the underground adventure, he protects his home village from wild Zoids.

6CC1C6.text: {window:04}Heroine of the second Game Boy game, Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after the underground adventure, she lives peacefully in Alster's home village.

6CC2A5.text: {window:04}The hero's rival in the second Game Boy game, Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after the underground adventure, he fights the wild Zoids causing destruction.

7024A9.full_text: {window:02}Fiona{window:03}Ancient Zoidian{window:04}F{window:05}Zoids: Part 1{window:06}A descendant of the Ancient Zoidians. After the fight with Prozen, she searches for Zoid Eve with Van. Later she becomes Dr. D's assistant. She remains a little absent-minded.

702659.full_text: {window:02}Moonbay{window:03}Courier{window:04}F{window:05}Zoids: Part 1{window:06}A courier of the wastelands who unexpectedly joins Van's journey. She acts as a big sister to Van and Fiona, sometimes stern and sometimes kind. Her theme song is famous.

703423.full_text: {window:02}Leena Toros{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}F 16{window:05}New Century{window:06}Dr. Toros's daughter and a Blitz Team warrior. Cute but fierce, she charges headlong into battle. A selfish troublemaker, she may take after her father.

703500.text: {window:02}Brad Hunter{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M 17{window:05}New Century{window:06}A freelance Blitz Team warrior who is strict about money. He pilots Command Wolf, then discovers Shadow Fox.
703500.full_text: {window:02}Brad Hunter{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M 17{window:05}New Century{window:06}A freelance Zoid Warrior hired by the Blitz Team. He is very strict about money. He pilots Command Wolf until an incident leads him to Shadow Fox.

7035E5.text: {window:02}Jamie Hemeros{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M 14{window:05}New Century{window:06}The Blitz Team's dependable tactician and mechanic. Usually gentle, he changes personality when he pilots Raynos.
7035E5.full_text: {window:02}Jamie Hemeros{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M 14{window:05}New Century{window:06}Dr. Toros's dependable assistant, Blitz Team tactician, and mechanic. Usually gentle and kind, his personality changes when he pilots Raynos.

7036C0.text: {window:02}Leon Toros{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}Dr. Toros's son and Leena's brother. He leaves the Blitz Team to train, then returns with a red Blade Liger and joins Naomi.
7036C0.full_text: {window:02}Leon Toros{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}A former Blitz Team warrior who leaves to train and find his ideal Zoid. He returns with a red Blade Liger and teams with Naomi. Dr. Toros's son and Leena's brother.

7037A7.text: {window:02}Naomi Fluegel{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}F{window:05}New Century{window:06}A solo marksman called the Red Comet. After Leon saves her in a Dark Battle, they form a team.
7037A7.full_text: {window:02}Naomi Fluegel{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}F{window:05}New Century{window:06}A beautiful marksman known as the Red Comet. She wins solo battles without teammates. Leon saves her from danger in a Dark Battle, and they form a team.

703898.text: {window:02}Harry Champ{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}The rich leader of the Champ Team. He buys the finest Zoids, loves Leena, and sees Bit as his rival.
703898.full_text: {window:02}Harry Champ{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}A man born to be a champion. His wealth buys the finest Zoids for his Champ Team. He loves Leena and sees Bit as his rival.

703979.text: {window:02}Fran Vogel{window:03}Four Generals{window:04}F 20{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}One of the Emperor's Four Generals. Normally calm, she reveals deep hatred for Earth, who shares her Imperial past.
703979.full_text: {window:02}Fran Vogel{window:03}Four Generals{window:04}F 20{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}One of the Emperor's Four Generals. Like Earth, she comes from the Empire. Normally calm, she openly shows hatred when facing Earth. What happened between them?

703A4E.text: {window:02}Gale Task{window:03}Four Generals{window:04}M 30{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}One of the Emperor's Four Generals. Once Jack's mentor in the Republic army, he now stands against his former pupil.
703A4E.full_text: {window:02}Gale Task{window:03}Four Generals{window:04}M 30{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}One of the Emperor's Four Generals. Once a Republic soldier and Jack's mentor, he now stands against Jack for reasons of his own.

703B1B.text: {window:02}Opis Kerone{window:03}Four Generals{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}An Imperial researcher exiled for dangerous experiments. He joins the Emperor's Four Generals to continue his work.
703B1B.full_text: {window:02}Opis Kerone{window:03}Four Generals{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}One of the Emperor's Four Generals. A leading Imperial Zoid researcher, he was exiled for dangerous experiments. This mad scientist joins the Four Generals to continue his research.

703BF4.text: {window:02}Blood Keel{window:03}Four Generals{window:04}M 16{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}The trusted leader of the Emperor's Four Generals. His fierce ambition makes him the prince's rival.
703BF4.full_text: {window:02}Blood Keel{window:03}Four Generals{window:04}M 16{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}A leading member of the Emperor's Four Generals and trusted by the Emperor. His burning ambition knows no limits. He is the prince's rival.

703CCB.text: {window:02}Emperor{window:03}Imperial Leader{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}A masked, mysterious conqueror. He captures Arcadia in one night and claims the title of Emperor.
703CCB.full_text: {window:02}Emperor{window:03}Imperial Leader{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}The mysterious figure behind the sudden invasion of Arcadia. Nobody knows the face beneath his mask. He conquers the kingdom in one night and claims the title of Emperor.

703D90.text: {window:02}Raven{window:03}Zoid Pilot{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Part 1{window:06}A gifted pilot raised by Prozen who hates Zoids. With Shadow and Geno Saurer, he battles Van.
703D90.full_text: {window:02}Raven{window:03}Zoid Pilot{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Part 1{window:06}A Zoid pilot raised by Prozen. Though he hates Zoids, he is a gifted pilot. With the black Organoid Shadow and Geno Saurer, he fights deadly battles against Van.

703E6F.text: {window:02}Hiltz{window:03}Zoid Pilot{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Part 2{window:06}An Ancient Zoidian with Ambient. He revives Death Stinger, then absorbs Dark Kaiser and fuses with Death Saurer.
703E6F.full_text: {window:02}Hiltz{window:03}Zoid Pilot{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Part 2{window:06}An Ancient Zoidian with the red Organoid Ambient. He revives Death Stinger and destroys the Republic. Later he absorbs Dark Kaiser and fuses with Death Saurer to threaten the world.

703F4E.text: {window:02}Stinger{window:03}Bounty Hunter{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}A cruel bounty hunter who enjoys poison gas and his enemies' suffering. He drinks milk for health and beauty.
703F4E.full_text: {window:02}Stinger{window:03}Bounty Hunter{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}Despite his gentle appearance, he is cruel and cowardly. He enjoys using poison gas and watching others suffer. At taverns, he drinks milk for health and beauty.

70402F.text: {window:02}Kirkland{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}The Tigers Team uses three Zaber Fangs. They keep losing to the Blitz Team, even after Dr. Laon helps them.
70402F.full_text: {window:02}Kirkland{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}The Tigers Team fields three Zaber Fangs. After losing to the Blitz Team, they lose repeatedly. Dr. Laon helps them recover, but their unlucky losing streak returns.

704113.text: {window:02}Dr. T{window:03}Zoid Researcher{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}An Arcadia Zoid Lab researcher. The King asks him to study Arcadia's ancient legacy.
704113.full_text: {window:02}Dr. T{window:03}Zoid Researcher{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}A researcher at Arcadia's Zoid Lab. At the King's request, he studies Arcadia's ancient legacy.

7041BC.text: {window:02}Major Polta{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}A Backdraft member who hijacks battles. His group rejects Commission rules and runs Dark Battles with illegal tactics.
7041BC.full_text: {window:02}Major Polta{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}A Backdraft member. This mysterious group rejects Zoid Battle Commission rules and runs Dark Battles with illegal tactics. Its members hijack Zoid battles and cause trouble everywhere.

704299.text: {window:02}Gunther Prozen{window:03}Marshal / Regent{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Part 1{window:06}A Guylos marshal and regent who plots to kill Rudolph. He revives Death Saurer to claim the throne and rule the world.
704299.full_text: {window:02}Gunther Prozen{window:03}Marshal / Regent{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Part 1{window:06}A Guylos Imperial marshal, later regent. He plots to kill Rudolph and become Emperor. At the same time, he revives Death Saurer to take over the world.

704368.text: {window:02}Dark Kaiser{window:03}Unknown{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Part 2{window:06}Prozen fused with Death Saurer's core. He manipulates Hiltz and Reese to revive himself with Zoid Eve's power.
704368.full_text: {window:02}Dark Kaiser{window:03}Unknown{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Part 2{window:06}Prozen, fused with Death Saurer's core. He secretly manipulates Hiltz and Reese to revive himself with Zoid Eve's power. Hiltz has already planned for this.

70443F.text: {window:02}Dr. D{window:03}Zoid Researcher{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}A famous Republic scientist who returns from retirement to help Van. He studies artificial snow and salts his coffee.
70443F.full_text: {window:02}Dr. D{window:03}Zoid Researcher{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}A famous Republic scientist who retires to research artificial snow. As fighting grows, he returns to help Van and friends with supplies and encouragement. He puts salt in his coffee.

704522.text: {window:02}Rudolph III{window:03}Guylos Emperor{window:04}M 10{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}The former Emperor's grandson. With Van's help, he defeats Prozen and brings peace to the Empire.
704522.full_text: {window:02}Rudolph Zeppelin III{window:03}Guylos Emperor{window:04}M 10{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}The former Emperor's grandson. Rosso kidnaps him before his coronation. Hunted by Prozen's assassins, he travels with Van to Guygalos, defeats Prozen, and becomes Emperor, bringing peace.

70461F.text: {window:02}Benjamin{window:03}Independent AI{window:04}?{window:05}New Century{window:06}A Champ Team AI in love with a Judge. He challenges Commission headquarters to meet him. The feelings seem mutual.
70461F.full_text: {window:02}Benjamin{window:03}Independent AI{window:04}?{window:05}New Century{window:06}A Champ Team member led by Harry and a maiden in love. Benjamin loves a Judge and challenges Commission headquarters to meet him. The feelings seem mutual.

7046FC.text: {window:02}Sebastian{window:03}Independent AI{window:04}?{window:05}New Century{window:06}A Champ Team member led by Harry. One of the rare members with a reasonable amount of common sense.
7046FC.full_text: {window:02}Sebastian{window:03}Independent AI{window:04}?{window:05}New Century{window:06}A Champ Team member led by Harry. One of the rare members with a reasonable amount of common sense.

704787.text: {window:02}Steve Toros{window:03}Team Manager{window:04}M 38{window:05}New Century{window:06}The Blitz Team's skilled manager and mechanic. A Zoid fanatic, he is Leon and Leena's father.
704787.full_text: {window:02}Steve Toros{window:03}Team Manager{window:04}M 38{window:05}New Century{window:06}The team's manager and mechanic. A skilled but hard-to-read engineer, rumored to be simply a Zoid fanatic. He is Leon and Leena's father.

70486A.text: {window:02}Dr. Laon{window:03}Team Manager{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}Dr. Toros's rival since their student days. After many losses to the Blitz Team, he joins Backdraft to try again.
70486A.full_text: {window:02}Dr. Laon{window:03}Team Manager{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}Dr. Toros's rival since their student days. He repeatedly challenges the Blitz Team and loses. The Backdraft Group later recruits him, and he plans further contests.

70494B.text: {window:02}Judge{window:03}Battle Referee{window:04}?{window:05}New Century{window:06}The fair referee and law of Zoid battles, sent by the Commission. As long as he is there, justice wins!
70494B.full_text: {window:02}Judge{window:03}Battle Referee{window:04}?{window:05}New Century{window:06}A fair referee and the law of Zoid battles, sent by the Zoid Battle Commission. As long as he is there, justice wins!

7049F4.text: {window:02}Dark Judge{window:03}Battle Referee{window:04}?{window:05}New Century{window:06}A Dark Battle referee AI. It crushes Judges and hijacks battles, though a Judge sometimes fights back.
7049F4.full_text: {window:02}Dark Judge{window:03}Battle Referee{window:04}?{window:05}New Century{window:06}An AI referee for Dark Battles. It crushes the Judge and hijacks battles, though the Judge sometimes fights back.

704AB9.text: {window:02}Gold Judge{window:03}Battle Referee{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}The Judge of Judges, who oversees the Colosseum final.
704AB9.full_text: {window:02}Gold Judge{window:03}Battle Referee{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}The Judge of Judges, who oversees the coliseum final.

704B3E.text: {window:02}Zeke{window:03}Organoid{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}Van's white Organoid, awakened alongside Fiona. He supports Shield Liger and Blade Liger.
704B3E.full_text: {window:02}Zeke{window:03}Organoid{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}Van's white Organoid companion, awakened by Van alongside Fiona. Always by Van's side, he supports Shield Liger and Blade Liger.

704C07.text: {window:02}Shadow{window:03}Organoid{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}Raven's black Organoid. Hiltz destroys him, but he revives and attacks Raven until Raven's tears restore his senses.
704C07.full_text: {window:02}Shadow{window:03}Organoid{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}Raven's black Organoid. Hiltz destroys him, but he revives and attacks Raven. Raven's tears bring him back to his senses.

704CC4.text: {window:02}Specular{window:03}Organoid{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids: Part 2{window:06}Reese's blue Organoid. He can draw out a fused Zoid's abilities beyond their limits.
704CC4.full_text: {window:02}Specular{window:03}Organoid{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids: Part 2{window:06}Reese's blue Organoid. He can draw out a fused Zoid's abilities beyond their limits.

704D4F.text: {window:02}Ambient{window:03}Organoid{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids: Part 2{window:06}Hiltz's red Organoid. His mysterious powers include joining Death Stinger's Zoid cores into one.
704D4F.full_text: {window:02}Ambient{window:03}Organoid{window:04}?{window:05}Zoids: Part 2{window:06}Hiltz's red Organoid. He has mysterious powers, including joining Death Stinger's Zoid cores into one.

704DE6.text: {window:02}King of Arcadia{window:03}Arcadia King{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}The prince's father. The Emperor captures him during the invasion of Arcadia. His whereabouts remain unknown.
704DE6.full_text: {window:02}King of Arcadia{window:03}Arcadia King{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}The prince's father. The Emperor captures him during the invasion of Arcadia. His whereabouts remain unknown.

704E83.text: {window:02}Queen of Arcadia{window:03}Arcadia Queen{window:04}F{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}The prince's mother. The Emperor captures her during the invasion of Arcadia. Her whereabouts remain unknown.
704E83.full_text: {window:02}Queen of Arcadia{window:03}Arcadia Queen{window:04}F{window:05}Zoids Saga{window:06}The prince's mother. The Emperor captures her during the invasion of Arcadia. Her whereabouts remain unknown.

704F5C.text: {window:02}Alster{window:03}Zoid Pilot{window:04}M{window:05}Silver Beast: Liger Zero{window:06}The hero of Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after his underground adventure, he protects his village from wild Zoids.
704F5C.full_text: {window:02}Alster{window:03}Zoid Pilot{window:04}M{window:05}Silver Beast: Liger Zero{window:06}Hero of the second Game Boy game, Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after the underground adventure, he protects his home village from wild Zoids.

70501D.text: {window:02}Palty{window:03}Underground{window:04}F{window:05}Silver Beast: Liger Zero{window:06}The heroine of Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after the underground adventure, she lives in Alster's village.
70501D.full_text: {window:02}Palty{window:03}Underground{window:04}F{window:05}Silver Beast: Liger Zero{window:06}Heroine of the second Game Boy game, Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after the underground adventure, she lives peacefully in Alster's home village.

7050E9.text: {window:02}Solid{window:03}Imperial Soldier{window:04}M{window:05}Silver Beast: Liger Zero{window:06}Alster's rival in Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after the underground adventure, he fights destructive wild Zoids.
7050E9.full_text: {window:02}Solid{window:03}Imperial Soldier{window:04}M{window:05}Silver Beast: Liger Zero{window:06}The hero's rival in the second Game Boy game, Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after the underground adventure, he fights the wild Zoids causing destruction.

7051BA.text: {window:02}Bluejem{window:03}Zoid Engineer{window:04}M{window:05}Silver Beast: Liger Zero{window:06}A Zoid engineer who helps Alster in Silver Beast: Liger Zero. He now maintains Zoids in Alster's home village.
7051BA.full_text: {window:02}Bluejem{window:03}Zoid Engineer{window:04}M{window:05}Silver Beast: Liger Zero{window:06}A Zoid engineer who helps the hero in the second Game Boy game, Silver Beast: Liger Zero. One year after the underground adventure, he maintains Zoids in Alster's village.

70529D.text: {window:02}Vega Obscura{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}A young warrior who predicts future positions. He pilots the legendary Ultimate X Berserk Fury, revived by Backdraft.
70529D.full_text: {window:02}Vega Obscura{window:03}Zoid Warrior{window:04}M{window:05}New Century{window:06}A skilled young Zoid Warrior who can predict future positions. He pilots the legendary Ultimate X Berserk Fury, revived by the Backdraft Group.

70535D.text: {window:02}Masked Man{window:03}Zoid Pilot{window:04}M{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}A mysterious Storm Sworder pilot who helps Van. He resembles Rosso, the leader of Desert Arcobaleno.

7053FF.text: {window:02}Masked Woman{window:03}Zoid Pilot{window:04}F{window:05}Zoids: Parts 1-2{window:06}A mysterious Storm Sworder pilot who resembles Viola and helps Van. Her catchphrase is "Catch you later!"
